name: runner-handoff-review-repair
goal: The runner's handoff owns a process only by id and start time, guards every signal with a fresh look at identity and program, keeps a service's protection for what it started, and always ends its cleanup within a bound.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Review of the frozen handoff found: ownership by historical pid; kill by raw pid after a batch; protection lost when the service is absent or filtered out; cleanup without bound or error result.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: 5 files written before repair. Against the frozen sources (bc9254fa, 5304f981, 3c85905f, 7c63fc00): 16 failed, 2 files could not load the new units, 1 control passed. /tmp/harness-repair-red-final.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: processDescendants, platformServices, settleProcesses, runIsolated repaired; new processProbes, cleanupDeadline, settlementReport, groupTeardown; CheckRunService failure text; desktop script one call.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same files: 24 new assertions and 22 earlier runner ones pass (46), record fixtures 15, frozen desktop 9c196712 and 1ca5ded1 7. /tmp/harness-repair-green.log, -records.log, -desktop.log. No Xcode tool run.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
